newsitem.title: USA: DLB Oil to buy Bonray for $12.7 million.
newsitem.headline: DLB Oil to buy Bonray for $12.7 million.

text.p: DLB Oil & Gas Inc. agreed to buy Bonray Drilling Corp. for about $12.7 million, or $30 per share in cash, the two energy exploration companies said Tuesday.
Under terms of the deal, Bonray will become a wholly-owned subsidiary of DLB Oil.
Shareholders owning about 54 percent of outstanding Bonray stock agreed to tender their shares, the companies said, and the transaction has been unanimously approved by the boards of both companies.
Bonray, based in Oklahoma City, currently owns 15 land rigs in Oklahoma, which have depth capabilities ranging from 7,000 to 25,000 feet.
DLB is an Oklahoma City-based company engaged in crude oil and natural gas exploration and development.
Bonray stock was up 62.5 cents at $26.125 and DLB was up $1 at $12.125 in midday trading on the Nasdaq system.
